data.name: Abyss of Shadows
data.description: Calls down a black sun of shadow whose crimson corona drinks the light from the battlefield. Beneath it the enemy grows slow and hollow, their strength and guard drawn into its void for a few precious moments.
data.battleDescription: %user raises a hand to the sky, and the light bleeds away as a black sun blooms above %target, its corona burning a deep and terrible crimson. Wisps of shadow spiral down from its rim and wind around %target, dragging them into a silence older than chakra itself. Beneath that dead star %target's strikes come slow and weightless, and their guard dissolves like mist drawn into the void. For a few precious moments, the black sun makes even the mightiest shinobi small.

data.name: Arctic Frost
data.description: Coat your blade in ice chakra and attack your enemy
data.battleDescription: Empowered by Blue Blade Eyes, %user chills the blade in elemental energy, encasing it in ice.

data.name: Atomic Shield
data.description: Create a barrier of particles that reflects part of the force directed at you and empowers your attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers the surrounding particles into a translucent barrier. Its surface turns part of every incoming impact back on the attacker while concentrating power into %user's strikes.

data.name: Azure Dragon Palm
data.description: Land devasting blows from the safety of your dragon.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a water dragon that encases them like armor. Dashing toward %target, each strike they deliver is mirrored by the dragon, landing devastating blows that leave %target battered and overwhelmed.

data.name: Blade Resonance
data.description: Synchronize your chakra with your weapon to deliver an icy strike that leaves the target vulnerable to Earth, Ice, Water, Wind and non-elemental attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their lineage through their weapon and forms a blade of ice, striking %target and disrupting their defenses against Earth, Ice, Water, Wind and non-elemental attacks.

data.name: Blast Shield
data.description: Using the concussive blast from an explosion to dampel the next attack you take.
data.battleDescription: %user creatives a massive explosion around themselves neutralizing all attacks coming towards them.

data.name: Blazing Fang Strike
data.description: Unleashes a great fire dragon whose burning fangs pierce straight through any guard. The fire takes root in its prey and burns on long after.
data.battleDescription: Flame gathers in %user's hands until it can no longer be contained, coiling into a great fire dragon with jaws agape. With a roar that shakes the air, the dragon lunges across the battlefield and sinks its burning fangs straight through %target's guard as if it were paper. The bite does not end with the strike; the fire takes root deep within %target, flaring anew with every breath that follows.

data.name: Blue Crimson
data.description: Use your bloodline to teleport to different locations striking the enemy
data.battleDescription: %user activates their bloodline, their eyes glow as patterned blades start to rotate in their pupils. %user disappears and reappears in seemingly random locations around %target, shifting his speed till his movements seem more illusionary than real. As %target becomes more and more disorientated, %user slashes and pierces %target from multiple angles.

data.name: Celestial Dew
data.description: Calls down a drop of starlight from a crescent moon that heals the user and wraps them in a silver ward.
data.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and the night seems to answer, a pale crescent moon blooming into being above them. From its tip falls a single drop of starlight that splashes across %user and spreads into a dome of soft, silver light. Wounds knit closed beneath its glow as the dome settles into a quiet ward that swallows the blows meant for its keeper. Within it, for a few heartbeats, the battle seems very far away.

data.name: Charge 4 Explosion
data.description: Spreading your chakra across the battle field causes micro-explosions to everything it comes into contact with.
data.battleDescription: %user covers the battlefield with their explosive chakra. Small explosions can be seen and heard happening all around you.

data.name: Crimson Impact
data.description: The user violently rends their target, leaving them exposed while siphoning vitality from the damage inflicted.
data.battleDescription: %user rends %target with brutal force, tearing open deep, bleeding wounds. The injury lingers, raw and unclosing, as %user drinks from it, each pulse of pain feeding %user’s strength.

data.name: Crimson Tithe
data.description: The user takes a toll in blood and time alike. The shock of the taking locks the victim in place, and what movement remains costs them dearly.
data.battleDescription: %user reaches into the space between heartbeats and takes what is owed. %target staggers, locked mid-motion, and even time itself grows expensive around them.

data.name: Crystal Cave
data.description: Surround your opponent with a crystal cave that damages them, leaves them vulnerable, and reflects incoming attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a cave of jagged crystals around %target, impaling them and leaving them vulnerable as the crystal walls reflect incoming attacks.

data.name: Crystal Sphere
data.description: Create a Sphere in which you protect yourself from all damage
data.battleDescription: %user encases themselves in a sphere made of pure crystal

data.name: Death's March
data.description: Release waves of chakra that strikes your target
data.battleDescription: %user envelops %target in a radiant chakra tunnel.  They unleash an unyielding wave of chakra, targeting their enemy's cells with relentless precision. As the assault subsides, the enemy's once-sturdy form crumbles, consumed by decay.

data.name: Decaying Touch
data.description: Touch your target and start to destroy their body through a dusty decay.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a dust cloud that surrounds %target. Dashing through the cloud, they appear in front of %target, placing their hand on them. %target slashes at %user, and their body becomes dust. Only after the dust has disappeared does %target realize that the part of their body that was touched is beginning to decay.

data.name: Drops of Renewal
data.description: Summons a glowing rain that turns the enemy's blows into healing and swells the user's chakra.
data.battleDescription: %user lifts their face to the sky as a single drop of water falls, then another, then a shimmering rain that gathers around them in slow, glowing spirals. Every wound that reaches %user is drawn into the rain and returned as living water, mending flesh even as it is torn. Fed by the current, %user's chakra swells, and each strike they throw lands with the force of a river in flood. For a short while, %user becomes the eye of a healing storm.

data.name: Drowning Strike
data.description: A fist of boiling water to the face.
data.battleDescription: %user covers their fist in scorching hot water before striking %target in the face, forcing most of that water down their nostrils.

data.name: Earthen Bastion
data.description: Calls the earth up to clad the user in a living fortress of molten-veined stone. Blows break against it, while every strike the user throws carries the weight of the mountain.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a heel into the ground, and the earth answers with a roar. Jagged plates of stone tear free of the battlefield and slam shut around %user, veined with molten light, a living fortress that moves as they move. Blows that land against it crack and scatter like rain on a cliff face, while every strike %user throws carries the weight of the mountain behind it. For as long as the stone holds, %user stands as immovable as the land itself.

data.name: Ethereal Nexus
data.description: A forbidden art that binds fire, water, earth and wind into a knot of chakra that drinks the life of its prey. The hunger it awakens leaves its user's own body exposed.
data.battleDescription: Fire, water, earth and wind spiral together between %user's hands, tightening into a single blinding knot of chakra that burns too bright to look upon. Released, the nexus tears into %target and drinks from the wound, pouring stolen life back into %user with every blow they land. But a power that devours does not rest easily in its host, and as the nexus feeds, %user's own body lies open, stripped raw by the hunger within.

data.name: Ethereal Rebirth
data.description:
A forbidden art that breaks the seal upon the user's soul and burns them anew in green flame, turning every wound into new life at the cost of their strength.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user cracks open the seal upon their own soul, and the elements burn through them in a roar of green flame that erupts outward to strike %target. In the fire's wake %user's body begins to unmake and remake itself, turning every wound they suffer into new life. The rebirth is not gentle; it pulls the strength from %user's arms to feed the blaze, and for a time their blows fall soft as ash. What rises from those flames is harder to kill than what entered them.

data.name: Glacial Volley
data.description: The wielder raises the Gaze and the air answers with an arsenal. A dozen lances of ice hang waiting, and every one of them has already chosen where it lands.
data.battleDescription: %user raises the trident and the cold assembles into ranks: lance after lance of pale ice hanging in the air, every point aimed at %target. %user lowers the tines, and winter volleys.

data.name: Hemocure
data.description: The user commands their blood to reject injury, sealing wounds and feeding on incoming harm to sustain an unnatural vitality.
data.battleDescription: %user’s blood writhes beneath %user_object skin, surging against the flow of nature. Wounds seal shut as they form, and each strike from %target is devoured, strength stolen as %user refuses to fall.

data.name: Hollow Veil
data.description:
Casts a shroud of ash-gray mist over the enemy that drains the fire from their strikes and turns their fury into the user's strength.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: With a whisper from %user, a veil of ash-gray mist drifts across the battlefield and settles over %target like a funeral shroud. It hollows %target out from within, draining the fire from their strikes until even their fiercest blows fall weak and distant. What the veil takes, it gives to its maker: every wound %target lands on %user returns to them as quiet, restoring breath.

data.name: Howitzer Crash
data.description: A devastating technique where you propel yourself at the target with an explosion before launching another massive explosion at them.
data.battleDescription: %user explodes the space behind them launching themselves at the opponent then detonates themselves as soon as they get close enough. The explosion weakens the opponent defenses.

data.name: Ice Shackles
data.description: The Gaze regards a rival and the cold agrees. Frost climbs them like a verdict, and for a breath the world simply declines to let them move.
data.battleDescription: %user levels the trident and its three eyes narrow. Frost races up %target from the ground, locking joint after joint, until %target stands shackled in blue ice.

data.name: Icebound Might
data.description: The wielder lets winter close over them like a second body. What it grips, it guards, and the cold it sheds sinks into their rival's every limb, dulling their blows before they land.
data.battleDescription: %user plants the trident and the cold closes over %user like armor, plate after plate of pale ice. The chill hangs heavy on every swing at %user, and the blows that land arrive dulled, only settling the frost.

data.name: Inferno Cataclysm
data.description: Unleashes a devastating explosion
data.battleDescription: Battle Description: %user channels the destructive power of their Bakuhatsu bloodline, their body surging with intense heat as the air around them distorts from the sheer energy. With a focused shout, %user slams their hands into the ground, causing the earth to tremble and crack. From the fissures erupts a cataclysmic explosion

data.name: Kinetic Nova
data.description: A blast of explosive chakra that disrupts all other chakra in the area
data.battleDescription: %user condenses their chakra into a ball, flinging it at %target which explodes showering the area in the tiny explosions. %target soon realizes that its very hard to gather mold their elemental chakra.

data.name: Kōsai Shippū
data.description: Enhances speed and generates crystal-laced shockwaves.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes crystal shockwaves at %target, striking with speed and recoiling damage.

data.name: Liquid Ember Shell
data.description: Encases the user in a shell of molten fire and water.
data.battleDescription: %user merges fire and water chakra to form a molten liquid shell that absorbs attacks, with fire burning weaker assaults and water dissipating impacts, providing adaptive defense against various threats.

data.name: Particle Cannon
data.description: The ultimate power comes with the ultimate price.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate triangle with their fingers, bringing forth a radiant orb that caresses %user's hand with a warm glow that both energizes and burns. Gradually, the sphere transforms, unfurling into a brilliant beam, propelled with purpose towards %target

data.name: Poisonous Senbon
data.description: A precise senbon strike laced with venom, designed to weaken the enemy with every hit.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a handful of senbon with surgical grace, each needle laced with a slow-acting poison. As the senbon strike %target, their body begins to stiffen and falter, chakra flow disrupted by the toxin’s subtle pulse. Though the wounds seem minor, the damage deepens with every breath.

data.name: Prism
data.description: Channel the light from the sun to enlighten the battlefield
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a blinding prism of light, striking %target dealing a devastating blow leaving them wounded.

data.name: Quintessential Flake
data.description: Using your blue blade, you turn your enemies ice pulling them towards you
data.battleDescription: %user channels their Blue Blade unleashing its energy upon %target. The freezing the surrounding area.

data.name: Reaper's Embrace
data.description: The user closes in and drains their target directly, tearing vitality from them in a violent, inescapable exchange.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward and crashes into %target, dragging %target close as crimson energy surges between them. With every heartbeat, %user rips vitality free, feeding on %target’s life as %user_object holds them through this vicious dance.

data.name: Replacement Technique
data.description: Basic Replacement used to escape or distract enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a quick seal and vanishes in a puff of smoke, leaving behind a decoy. In the same instant, they reappear elsewhere on the battlefield.

data.name: Ring of Spilled Blood
data.description: A spiral of spent blood is thrown across the ground. It opens what stands against the user, and what it opens, it weakens.
data.battleDescription: %user spills a spiral across the ground and it turns outward, hungry. Enemies caught in the ring are opened, and their blows leave the circle duller than they entered.

data.name: Sanguine Plague
data.description: The user seeds a rival's blood with a burning sickness. The plague opens them to harm and eats at them from within, while the user's own blood refuses all affliction.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a drop of tainted blood onto %target and it takes root, burning as it spreads. %target is opened and eaten from within, while %user_object own veins run too hot for any sickness to touch.

data.name: Sapphire Command
data.description: A complex series of slashes drops your opponent to their knees before you.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a pulse of Blue Blade chakra across the battlefield. As the wave passes through %target, their chakra flow freezes, increasing their vulnerability.

data.name: Scorch Break
data.description: Your most basic technique as a wielder of the Boil style
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into their palms, turning it into steaming liquid. Dashing forward, %user unleashes a flurry of punches, each strike searing %target's body and leaving burn marks in its wake.

data.name: Searing Might
data.description: A blazing chakra technique that hardens the user’s body, reducing incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense chakra into their core, igniting it into a controlled blaze that spreads through their body. The heat reinforces their muscles and chakra pathways, forming a shield of inner strength. As attacks come in, the energy absorbs and deflects the impact, allowing the user to withstand damage with unshakable resolve.

data.name: Soul Shackles
data.description: A cursed chakra technique that deals direct damage by tearing through the enemy’s spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures cursed chakra chains and hurls them at %target. Upon contact, the chains pierce through physical defenses and latch onto the target’s spirit, delivering a crushing blow to their core. The pain is sharp and sudden, striking deeper than the flesh and rattling their chakra from within.

data.name: Subaku Palace
data.description: A forbidden art stolen from Subaku Castle that calls the demon palace into the waking world, sapping every enemy beneath its gates while pouring dark power into its master.
data.battleDescription: %user presses a palm to the earth, and a sigil of burning gold spirals outward across the battlefield. With a sound like grinding stone, gates of red sandstone carved with snarling faces tear free of the ground, and the shadow of the demon palace falls across the field. Beneath those gates strength drains away and every strike grows timid, while the palace pours its dark power into the one who summoned it. For a time the battlefield belongs to the demon palace, and to its master.

data.name: Summoning: Jade
data.description: Summon a beautiful but fierce warrior to the battlefield
data.battleDescription: %user creates a cocoon made of crystal, out of it a beautiful warrior appears

data.name: Surfing Strike
data.description: A series of gliding movements atop boiling water
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a torrent of water, flooding the battlefield. Using their Boil affinity, they glide seamlessly over the steaming surface, while the boiling water scalds %target causing %user to take less damage.

data.name: Tempest Cleave
data.description:
A spinning storm of razor wind that carves through everything around the user, friend and foe alike. Its cuts keep singing long after it fades.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user plants their feet and turns once, and the air itself becomes a blade. A storm of razor wind erupts outward in a howling ring, carving through everything within its reach, for the tempest knows no allegiance. Those caught in it are left with wounds that will not close, each cut still singing with the wind long after the gale has passed. In its wake, even the hardiest guard lies in ribbons.

data.name: Thousand Strike
data.description: The user unleashes a relentless barrage that shatters defenses, leaving the target exposed to further harm.
data.battleDescription: %user descends in a frenzy of strikes, each blow tearing through %target with merciless precision. Defenses collapse under the onslaught, and in the wake of the assault, %target is left wide open, unable to withstand what follows.

data.name: Unholy Enhancement
data.description: The user awakens a corrupted vitality, amplifying their strength while their body shrugs off harm with unnatural resilience.
data.battleDescription: A dark pulse spreads through %user’s veins, quickening with hungry force. %user’s strikes land harder, fueled by something that does not tire, while blows from %target sink shallow, unable to fully pierce what refuses to weaken.

data.name: Venomous Phobia.
data.description: A fear-inducing poison technique that increases how much damage the target takes.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a silent, airborne toxin that bypasses the skin and seeps into the mind. As %target inhales the faint mist, illusions twist into phobias—hallucinations of venomous creatures crawling beneath the surface. The fear tightens their body and frays their nerves, making them far more vulnerable to incoming attacks as their composure breaks.

data.name: Windshear Decay
data.description: Razor sharp wind slashes that leave lasting and decaying effects
data.battleDescription: %user forms a series of intricate hand seals which summons forth the power of the winds that once quelled Fujin's fury. With a swift motion, they unleash a torrent of razor-sharp wind slashes that tear through the air towards %target. The wind howls with a vengeful fury, and as the invisible blades connect, they slice deep into %target's flesh, leaving behind festering wounds. The air around %target grows heavy with the scent of decay as the slashes begin to fester and deepen over time, continuing to tear at their flesh with each passing moment.
